Hero.Description: Meet Antoine Capitain, the self-proclaimed code wizard who can turn idea into websites, tools or other solution with caffeine. His passion for web and software programming has equalled only by your ideas.
Hero.When: when I'm not working on my day job.

Experience.Title: Work Experience

Tools.Title: All my tools
Tools.Description: Over the years, I've explored many languages and frameworks, evolving from my first JavaScript scripts to complex full stack projects in Next.js, Nuxt, Golang and .Net. Each project has taught me valuable lessons, from user authentication management user authentication, optimizing performance, and creating fluid, intuitive user interfaces.

LatestRepos.Title: Latest Repositories
LatestRepos.Description: Here are some of the latest repositories I've worked on. From my first hello world to my latest projects, with {repos} repositories in between. I've learned a lot from each and every one of them.

About.Title3: and I'm a full stack software developer.
About.Description: Ever since I was a child, I've been obsessed with technology. When I wasn't disassembling joysticks or game consoles, I was learning to code. A few years later, I became a code ninja in my own right, with an insatiable thirst for creating applications and functional tools.
About.WhenNotBusy: When I'm not busy slaying bugs and writing code. I'm usually busy indulging in my favorite hobbies: gaming, new technologies and motorbike.
About.Timeline: Here's a timeline of what I've been upto

Events.Title: I share on linkedin
Events.Content: I don't understand why people are still interested in PHP when new technologies such as React and .Net are making it possible to build applications that are clearly more powerful. I've built a lot of things, from small experiments to complete web applications, and every project shows my love for coding and problem solving.

Contributions.Title: Committing Code and Crimes Against
Contributions.Content: A place where you can witness my caffeinated coding adventures and see just how much coffee it takes to fuel my commits. From my first "Hello World" to my latest breakthrough, and everything in between.

Projects.Description: Come and discover the fruits of my labor, from small experiments to complete web applications, each project illustrates my love for programming and creating solutions.

MapTilesCutter.Description: Golang module that allows users to cut tiles from images for map systems like Mapbox or Google Maps.

EmojiGenerator.Description: Next.js app that allows users to generate emojis using a generative AI.

TechMotion.Description: Next.js boilerplate for building web apps with Shadcn UI, Prisma ORM, Framer Motion, BetterAuth, Vercel, and other tools.

FromA2B.Description: Next.js app. Final study project. The application allows users to plan a trip based on user-defined stops.

Staracter.Description: Next.js app. Character library for the Star Citizen game.

SnakeGame.Description: WPF C# application. Snake game where I experimented with pathfinding algorithms like A*.

StarTrad.Description: C# utility that allows Star Citizen players to install and update the community translation of the game autonomously.

GameTrip.Description: React SPA with .Net backend. The application uses Mapbox to display an interactive map of video game locations and view information about real places.

ForzaHorizon5InteractiveLiveMap.Description: React SPA with .Net backend. The application allows users to view an interactive map of Forza Horizon 5. The backend implements WebSocket streams based on SignalR for real-time map data updates, as well as a DNS stream to retrieve player data. The map is generated using the Leaflet.js library along with tiles generated using my MapTiles Cutter project

GuanajuatoRP.Description: Creation of a Forza Horizon 5 role-playing game server. Development of a Discord bot and a .Net API for user data management. Implementation of a complex economy with periodic events. Addition of advanced features such as permission management, command handling, role management, and salon templates.
